privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Wanderlust.lv collects, uses and protects your personal data when you visit the website, use the contact form or make a booking request.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.text: Wanderlust.lv is operated by social.tech SIA (Reg. 40203514705, VAT LV40203514705, Augusta Dombrovska 75k-2-8, Rīga LV-1015, Latvia), on behalf of Ilze Gulbe (SIA "Creatus Real Estate"). If you have any questions about this policy, please email us at info@socialtech.lv.

collected.title: What data we collect
items: Information you provide: name, email address, phone number, country, preferred language, tour or transfer details, and any special requests or notes.
Booking details: chosen service, date, time, number of people and related travel information.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, and cookies (see the Cookies section below).

usage.title: How we use your data
items: To respond to your enquiry and confirm your booking.
To arrange and provide the requested tour, hike or transfer.
To communicate with you before and after the service.
To improve the website and understand how visitors use it.

legal_basis.title: Legal basis for processing
items: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps when you make a booking.
Your consent for optional cookies and marketing communications.
Legitimate interest in improving our services and keeping the website secure.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share it with trusted service providers when necessary to fulfil your request (for example, payment processors, transport operators or email services), and only under confidentiality obligations.

retention.title: How long we keep your data
retention.text: We keep your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil your booking, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes and enforce our agreements. Typically, booking records are retained for up to two years unless a longer period is required by law.

rights.title: Your rights
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction or deletion of your data.
Object to or restrict certain processing activities.
Withdraw your consent at any time.
Lodge a complaint with the Latvian Data State Inspectorate or another relevant supervisory authority.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.text: We use essential cookies to make the website work. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors use the site. You can manage your preferences through your browser settings.

security.title: Security
security.text: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), access controls, and secure hosting. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, however.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.text: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or your personal data, please contact us at info@socialtech.lv or by phone at +371 20042830.

consent.title: We use cookies
consent.body: We use essential cookies to make the site work, and optional cookies to analyse traffic and improve your experience. Choose what to allow.
consent.necessary_desc: Core site functionality. Cannot be disabled.
consent.analytics_desc: Helps us understand how visitors use the site.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how Wanderlust.lv uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website.

what.title: What cookies are
what.text: Cookies are small text files that your browser stores on your device so the site can remember your choices and collect statistics.

types.title: Cookies we use
types.necessary: Necessary — required for the site to function, language selection and security. Cannot be disabled.
types.analytics: Analytics — help us understand how visitors use the site (e.g. Google Analytics). Only set with your consent.
types.marketing: Marketing — measure ad effectiveness and personalise content. Only set with your consent.

retention.title: How long cookies are kept
retention.text: Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies are kept for up to 12 months unless you delete them earlier.

manage.title: How to manage cookies
manage.text: You can change your choice at any time by opening the cookie settings. Cookies can also be managed or deleted from your browser settings.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: We may update this policy. The current version will always be available on this page.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Wanderlust.lv website and services. By using the site, you agree to these terms.

provider.title: Service provider
provider.text: Wanderlust.lv is operated by social.tech SIA (Reg. 40203514705, VAT LV40203514705, Augusta Dombrovska 75k-2-8, Rīga LV-1015, Latvia) on behalf of Ilze Gulbe (SIA "Creatus Real Estate"). Contact: info@socialtech.lv, +371 20042830.

services.title: Services
services.text: The website offers information about guided tours, hikes and transfers in the Gauja Valley and allows you to submit booking requests. A booking is considered confirmed only after a written confirmation is received.

booking.title: Bookings and payments
items: A booking request is not a contract until confirmed.
Prices are shown in EUR, including applicable taxes.
Payment and cancellation terms are communicated before confirming the booking.
Suitable clothing, footwear and physical fitness are the visitor's responsibility.

user.title: User obligations
items: Provide truthful and accurate information when booking.
Follow the guide's instructions and safety rules during the tour.
Do not use the site for unlawful purposes or to disrupt its operation.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.text: All site content — text, images, logos and design — is protected by copyright and belongs to social.tech SIA or its partners. Reproduction without written permission is prohibited.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.text: We aim to provide accurate information but do not guarantee its complete correctness. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect losses arising from the use of the site or services, except in cases of gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

force.title: Force majeure
force.text: We are not liable for failure to perform obligations caused by weather, natural disasters, actions of public authorities or other circumstances beyond our control.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.text: We may update these terms from time to time. The current version will always be available on this page.

law.title: Applicable law
law.text: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Latvia. Disputes are resolved by the competent courts of the Republic of Latvia.
